title: My channel was deleted, but...I AM BACK! (A Great Victory Against Censorship)
summary: He explains that YouTube terminated his channel and Google account without warning or strikes after a video criticising sexualised media that used Ikkitousen footage, and that it was restored within 24 hours after a community campaign. He defends using the footage, calls YouTube hypocritical, thanks supporters by name and vows to keep tackling politically incorrect topics.
claims: His channel was deleted after a video arguing that sexual media hijacks male libido, illustrated with Ikkitousen season 1 footage that YouTube itself hosted without age restriction
Ikkitousen, watched as a boy, was his gateway to softcore and then hardcore porn, an addiction that took him a long time to break
Porn and sexualised media damage the lives of millions of men
He showed the images so viewers would feel their pull and to expose YouTube's hypocrisy in hosting and even selling the same show

YouTube terminated the channel and his Google account with no warning or strikes; it was restored in 24 hours after a Twitter, Instagram and fax campaign with help from Alpha Destiny, Jeff Nippard, Mario Tomic and others
The only real way to reach a human at YouTube is Twitter, ideally with big accounts amplifying you
The current era may be the best in YouTube fitness history because of the quality of the creators
The underground fitness community is small but the strongest, because it believes in everyone's right to express themselves
He will keep tackling politically incorrect topics but won't re-upload the uncensored video, since YouTube could use it as a pretext
